abstract: Emerging technologies and workflow inefficiencies are key drivers of innovation within media production. Our society is filled with engineers who constantly look to solve problems for our industry or invent new tools that continue to expand the options available for creatives to bring their visions to life. This issue of the Motion Imaging Journal shares a mixture of technical papers, applications, and tutorials that dive into some of these latest solutions and future-looking technologies for media production workflows.
